differences.rationale: Under the maintainer’s later delegation of conservative TypeScript choices, Codex retains the genuine current MatMenuItem parent and requires Angular DI construction, preserving Material16 legacy markup/styles. The earlier historical-implementation approval is not authority for this different choice. Only this authenticated historical menu-item overload changes; zero-argument DI construction replaces both manual forms. The finite owner-bound constructor/factory contract and actual execution are required; token identity, optional flags, errors and other APIs remain enforced.
